purpose: Reference questions for evaluating whether an AI answer cites VextJS documentation and preserves public capability boundaries.

questions.question: How does same-route navigation fail safely when the page-envelope protocol is incompatible?

questions.question: Where should a team begin a scoped VextJS support or integration conversation?
